scope: breakpoint hazard guard: known-bad addresses are refused, unknown ones warn
background: round 100: 0x4475F0 was used as a breakpoint and the client silently stalled at state 8 with zero traces; the same body worked without it
rounds 68-70: mid-function addresses (0x471B9E, 0x471C5C) silently corrupted the parse and produced no records
the failure mode is always the same: no error, just missing data - the most expensive kind of bug in this project

implementation.safe_list: SAFE_BREAKPOINTS: the 21 addresses proven to work on this build
behaviour: a hazard address aborts the launch with an explicit message pointing at docs/SNAPSHOT-FORMAT.md section 6 (exit 1)
an address outside the safe list prints a warning that names the exact symptom to look for

verified.hazard: --breakpoint 0x4475f0:Glass -> exit 1, 'refusing known-hazard breakpoints ... silently break the client'

why_it_matters: this failure mode has no error signal, so it can only be prevented, not detected
the guard turns a silent multi-session trap into an immediate, explanatory refusal
